description: Searches public procurements by term. Free. Returns the object, the agency, the state (UF), the modality and the procurement id.

abertas.description: '1' for only procurements with an open proposal period.

filtros.description: JSON up to 2048 characters: excluir and municipios (up to 10 expressions of 3 to 80 characters; municipalities by exact name or IBGE code), orgao_cnpj (14 digits), modalidades (up to 10 codes from 1 to 19), valor_min and valor_max (reais from 0 to 1e15). Example: {"excluir":["usado"],"modalidades":[6]}.

name: search_tenders
title: Search tenders
